Class BoardController

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.game.controller.game.BoardController
All Implemented Interfaces:
Board
public class BoardController extends Object implements Board
Main board controller managing the game board state and brick operations. Handles brick movement, rotation, collision detection, and line clearing.
